objective: Strictly satisfy WorldArena 2.0 Track 2 and obtain at least +3 percentage points and +3 percent relative Adjust Bottle success over the original Pi0.5 baseline by jointly optimizing the submitted world model and diagnosing the policy-learning signal, while preserving the unmodified official Pi0.5 start, reward, RL algorithm and fixed budget and evaluating the resulting policy only in an independent real RoboTwin environment without a world model or MPC action selection.

submission_boundary.local_policy_checkpoints: diagnostic and acceptance artifacts only; never participant-side action selection

declared_data_policy.user_authorization_update_2026_08_11: The earlier self-imposed prohibition on newly synthesized data is removed. Traceable synthetic data may be used when useful, subject to the isolation and submission-boundary rules below.
declared_data_policy.offline_synthetic_data_from_public_RoboT: allowed when generated before model freeze, legally authorized, declared, provenance-hashed, episode-disjoint from all policy-development and acceptance seeds, and used only to train or validate the world model
declared_data_policy.successful_oracle_demonstrations: allowed as offline world-model supervision only; forbidden for Pi0.5 behavior cloning, participant-side action injection, MPC, policy selection, or real-environment acceptance
declared_data_policy.public_external_data: allowed when licensed, declared, provenance-hashed, and kept out of evaluation splits
declared_data_policy.final128_real_evaluation_seeds: evaluation only; forbidden for training or model selection
declared_data_policy.development22_real_evaluation_seeds: policy candidate selection only; forbidden for world-model training
